info.title: OMA LwM2M Periodic Sensor Upload (Object ID 10495)

Periodic_Sensor_Upload.label: Periodic Sensor Upload
Periodic_Sensor_Upload.description: The autosen Periodic Sensor Upload object can be used to upload sampled sensor data at periodic intervals

Sensor_Sampler_Path.label: Sensor Sampler Path
Sensor_Sampler_Path.description: Link to an object instance of the Periodic Sensor Sampler Object

Upload_Start_Time.label: Upload Start Time
Upload_Start_Time.description: Specifies the number of seconds after midnight UTC from which the upload should be started

Upload_Interval.label: Upload Interval
Upload_Interval.description: Specifies the Interval at which the upload is to be repeated from the Upload Start Time.

Upload_Count.label: Upload Count
Upload_Count.description: Specifies the number of intervals to be performed in the upload interval, starting from the Upload Start Time

Upload_Days_of_the_Week.label: Upload Days of the Week
Upload_Days_of_the_Week.description: Specifies the days of the week when an upload should occur. The value is a single byte (bitmask), where Bit 0 = Sunday, Bit 1 = Monday, ..., Bit 6 = Saturday

Upload_Recurrence.label: Upload Recurrence
Upload_Recurrence.description:
Specifies the Recurrence in days in which the Uploader will be executed. This works in combination with "Sampling Days of the Week" (ID 5),  
        allowing finer control over when sampling occurs.
